added: When Device Sync asks you to choose between versions, it now shows exactly what's different: which dialects, themes, shorthands or snippets are only on one device or differ, which details of a dance differ (with figures compared line by line), and which dances a program's versions don't share. With several items, choose Show differences on one to see its comparison. Each version also says when it was last changed.

syncCollectionEntries, compareSyncCollection and syncDifferingFields compare two versions of a conflicted record; SyncConflictGroup carries this device's copy projected to shareable fields and its last-changed time (CompendiumSyncStorage.recordUpdatedAt).
